item.zero_seven_nine.screwdriver.desc1: RMB Camera to select, then RMB doors/devices to link.
item.zero_seven_nine.screwdriver.desc2: Shift + RMB Camera to open room & zone config.
item.zero_seven_nine.screwdriver.desc3: RMB Map Node to configure 2D tactical schematic position.
item.zero_seven_nine.room_selector.desc1: RMB block to add next perimeter point.
item.zero_seven_nine.room_selector.desc2: Shift + RMB to undo last point.
item.zero_seven_nine.room_selector.desc3: RMB on Map Node or Camera to link all points.
item.zero_seven_nine.room_selector.desc4: LMB on block to reset all points.
item.zero_seven_nine.room_selector.linke: Linked %s boundary points to room! Volume: %sx%sx%s blocks.
item.zero_seven_nine.map_tablet.desc1: Right-click to open 079 Map Editor & CAD Blueprint Designer.
item.zero_seven_nine.map_tablet.desc2: Freeform vertex point editing, drag-and-drop rooms, rotation, and camera linking.
